video_title: Head Coach Jordan Ott Postgame Media Availability | 10-21-26

quotes.speaker: Jordan Ott
quotes.summary_phrase: Jordan Ott discusses the team's uncharacteristic performance in the season opener
quotes.excerpt: Incredibly emotional to start the game. Before the ball was even tipped, they did a better job.
quotes.quote: Incredibly emotional to start the game. Before the ball was even tipped, they did a better job of using that to their advantage. We talked about it before the game, there were a lot of highs and lows, and we knew it was going to be emotional for those guys. They used it to their advantage and that first quarter we just absolutely got blitzed and weren't able to overcome it.
quotes.social_post: Jordan Ott says the Suns were overwhelmed by the emotion of the season opener and got blitzed in the first quarter. He noted the team struggled to overcome the early deficit after failing to manage the high energy of the game.

structured.context: Head coach Jordan Ott discusses the team's emotional start and poor performance in the first quarter of the season opener.

quotes.speaker: Jordan Ott
quotes.summary_phrase: Jordan Ott confirms injury to Josh Okogie's right hip
quotes.excerpt: It was definitely that right hip, just for sure right hip.
quotes.quote: It was definitely that right hip, just for sure right hip. It was there at the end of the second quarter.
quotes.social_post: Jordan Ott confirms Josh Okogie suffered a right hip injury during the second quarter of tonight's game.

structured.context: Head coach Jordan Ott confirms that Josh Okogie suffered a right hip injury during the second quarter of the game.

quotes.speaker: Jordan Ott
quotes.summary_phrase: Jordan Ott on the impact of early shots by Donovan Clingan
quotes.excerpt: When Clingan hits those first two, that gets the energy going and the crowd up.
quotes.quote: When Clingan hits those first two, that gets the energy going and the crowd up. And then what do you feel like manifested after that? Was it just you guys maybe speeding up, trying to get back in it after that, or was it just Portland? Some of those shots were contested that they hit for three, then some with Dame just doing what he does. It takes a little bit of both. It's always somewhere in between.
quotes.social_post: Jordan Ott credits Donovan Clingan for shifting the momentum early in the game, noting that the crowd energy and contested shots made it difficult for the Suns to settle in.

structured.context: Head coach Jordan Ott reflects on the impact of Donovan Clingan's early shots on the game's momentum.

quotes.speaker: Jordan Ott
quotes.summary_phrase: Jordan Ott evaluates Donovan Clingan's performance in his debut
quotes.excerpt: Throwing young guys into the fire, that's what you see. And he'll learn from this.
quotes.quote: It was probably a tough assessment. Again, throwing young guys into the fire, that's what you see. And he'll learn from this, and he's part of the group that's out there to start the game when that avalanche is coming. We need him to grow, he will continue to grow. We need him to take a step, he'll take steps.
quotes.social_post: Jordan Ott says it was a tough assessment for rookie Donovan Clingan in his debut, but emphasized that the team needs him to grow and take steps forward after being thrown into the fire.

structured.context: Head coach Jordan Ott assesses the performance of Donovan Clingan during his debut game.

quotes.speaker: Jordan Ott
quotes.summary_phrase: Jordan Ott addresses Portland's dominance in hustle plays
quotes.excerpt: We lost the possession game by eight and they outshoot you.
quotes.quote: We talked about it. Again, we lost the possession game by eight and they outshoot you. So we were trying to make a couple early subs to bring some of our possession guys in into the game. It's a balance of it all, but that's typically how we play. Give them credit, they did it last year too. This was one of those teams that played extremely hard and they added some skill now to that group, and it all clicked tonight.
quotes.social_post: Jordan Ott says the Suns lost the possession game by eight tonight, noting that Portland played extremely hard and added enough skill to make everything click against them.

structured.context: Head coach Jordan Ott discusses the team's struggles with possession and praises the effort of the Portland team.
